title: Customize your app for Assistive Access
description: Assistive Access is a distinctive, focused iOS experience that makes it easier for people with cognitive disabilities to use iPhone and iPad independently. In iOS and iPadOS 26, you can customize your app when it’s running in Assistive Access to give people greater ease and independence. Learn how to tailor your app using the AssistiveAccess SwiftUI scene type, and explore the key design principles that can help you create a high-quality Assistive Access experience for everyone.
